title: The ModelClient return-shape migration omits existing typed test fixtures and assertions, notably tests/unit/w
text: The ModelClient return-shape migration omits existing typed test fixtures and assertions, notably tests/unit/webhook/webhook-job.test.ts and the benchmark test fixture clients, which currently return/assert strings. They must be included in the migration and test plan or the stated typecheck/full-suite gate cannot pass.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in a244cab, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
